breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated sign convention by redefining positive shear and bending moment after already specifying upward shear on the left cut face and sagging as positive.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two contradictory sign conventions. The ground truth resolved this by removing the second, incorrect convention and keeping the first one ('positive shear V upward on the left cut face and positive bending moment M causing sagging'). The generated specification failed to resolve the inconsistency in the same way; it removed the correct convention and kept the incorrect one ('positive shear downward on the left cut face and positive bending moment as hogging').
